review:
Phoenix DuelReels is an East Asian fantasy take on the duel mechanic, with a Phoenix facing a Water Dragon on every expanded reel. VS symbols expand into wild reels when they would join a win, and the survivor's multiplier covers the reel, with several reels in one win adding together.

The twist is Resurrection Spins: if the Phoenix loses at least one duel, you get a respin with at least one more duel. So a loss in a duel isn't quite final. The cap is 10,000x, and the art is some of the most polished in the DuelReels series.
